# standplass.com

> Competitions, results, and statistics for NSF (Norges Sportsskytterforbund) pistol and revolver shooting.

standplass.com is an open-source, non-profit, MIT-licensed site that scrapes and
serves Norwegian shooting-sport competition results (skyting.no / NSF API),
independent of any single club. Clubs can embed results on their own website
via a Web Component instead of running their own scraper.

The site is under continuous development and may change without notice.

## Pages

- / — Landing page
- /felt — Feltskyting results (pistol)
- /bane — Baneskyting results (pistol)
- /klubb — Per-club leaderboard rankings
- /nasjonalt — National top-list rankings across all NSF branches
- /terminliste — Competition calendar (all branches)
- /norgesfelt — Norgesfelt results (national field-pistol series)

## Embedding

Any club can embed standplass results on their own site:

```html
<script src="https://standplass.com/embed.js"></script>
<standplass-results view="felt"></standplass-results>
```

Supported views: `felt`, `bane`, `terminliste`.
Planned views: `klubb`, `nasjonalt`.

Optional attributes: `klubb` (club name filter), `club` (brand preset),
`mode` (light/dark theme), `sync-url` (opt-in URL sync), `compact` (terminliste widget).

## Source code

https://github.com/teonat/standplass.com

## Data sources

- skyting.no / NSF API (stevneresultater, ranking, terminliste)
- norgesfelt.no (Norgesfelt field-pistol series results)
